title: prepare_return response
description: One round of the preparation loop. Every field is REQUIRED and may be empty: an optional field is one a caller forgets to read, and this service has already been bitten by exactly that.

outcome.description: What this round concluded. `error` is deliberately NOT a value here: a transient failure is reported as an ENGINE_UNAVAILABLE error envelope, never as a result, and putting a value in this enum that the service never emits would freeze a promise nothing keeps.

versions.description: What this answer was computed against. The client checks the tax year echoes its request before accepting the result -- a return computed for another year is wrong in a way no field-level check catches.

gaps.description: Required inputs not supplied, each naming the lines it would have built. Reported ALL AT ONCE: a preparer told one missing figure per round trip pays a full resolve for each.

assumptions.description: What the service decided about this taxpayer without asking -- claims nobody supplied and no field lets them contradict -- plus any optional input that was absent and still moved a number. The client presents these at submit time before rendering.

unasked_boundary.description: Income and facts this service CANNOT ask for and cannot compute. The sharpest hazard in the design: the cloud only asks for what it supports, so a taxpayer with interest income yields a wages-only fact set, nothing refuses, and `complete` is a wrong number. A complete return silent about this is worse than a refusal.

forms.description: The resolved return. EMPTY unless the outcome is `complete`: a half-answered return must not be mistakable for a draft.

assumption_details.description: Every assumption as a structured pair: `statement` is the sentence also served in `assumptions` (the two views are one derivation); `fact` is the service field the statement is about — the cell a client may paint or ask in — or null for an assumption resting on no field a caller could set.

fact.description: The fact path to supply, in the shape the client can write back. A gap the caller cannot answer is a question nobody can act on.

consumed_by.description: The [form, line] pairs this input would have built, transitively.

derived_from.description: Fact paths this line was derived from.
